title: Layla
description: 《Layla》描寫一段充滿渴望、執著與痛苦的單戀。歌中的主角原本只是想安慰感情受挫的 Layla，卻在相處過程中不知不覺深深愛上了她。這份感情令他的世界天翻地覆，甚至願意放下尊嚴，苦苦哀求對方回應自己的愛意。他認為 Layla 一直在逃避內心的感受，希望她能放下自尊，給彼此一個相愛的機會。然而，面對不確定的未來，他始終害怕自己的真心最終付諸流水。歌曲反覆呼喚 Layla 的名字，流露出強烈的思念與無助。最終，《Layla》傳達的是愛情中的脆弱、渴望與無奈：當一個人深陷於得不到回應的感情，即使願意付出一切，也未必能換來對方的愛，而這份無法掌握的心意，往往令人難以釋懷。

vocabulary.usage: 當一個人開始覺得沒有陪伴時使用。
options: I get lonely my shoes before school.
The sandwich gets lonely in five minutes.
I get lonely when all my friends are away.
Please get lonely the window for me.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：朋友都不在時，會感到孤單。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：get lonely 是感到寂寞，不能表示穿鞋；可以說 I put on my shoes.
錯誤：三明治通常不會有寂寞的感受；可說 The sandwich gets cold.
正確：朋友都不在時，會感到孤單。
錯誤：get lonely 不是打開窗戶；應說 Please open the window.

vocabulary.usage: 描述人在旁邊，或在困難時支持對方。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「By your side」？
options: I put by your side in my soup.
I will stay by your side when you need help.
My phone is by your side of happy.
We went by your side at eight o’clock yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示需要幫忙時會陪在對方身邊。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：by your side 不是食材；可以說 I put salt in my soup.
正確：表示需要幫忙時會陪在對方身邊。
錯誤：這個片語不能這樣連接形容詞；可說 My phone is next to you.
錯誤：by your side 不是時間或交通方式；可說 We went home at eight.

vocabulary.usage: 當事情持續的時間比希望的長很多時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Much too long」？
options: My dog is much too long happy today.
She much too long her breakfast.
We bought much too long in the shop.
I waited much too long for the bus.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示等公車等得太久。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：much too long 形容時間過長，不是這樣修飾 happy。
錯誤：不能把 much too long 當成動詞；可說 She took too long to eat breakfast.
錯誤：買東西要用商品或數量；可說 We stayed in the shop much too long.
正確：表示等公車等得太久。

vocabulary.usage: 跪在地上時使用；也可能比喻懇求。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「On my knees」？
options: I was on my knees to look for my lost key.
I ate on my knees with a blue pencil.
The bus was on my knees at the station.
I put my homework on my knees tomorrow.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示跪下來找掉落的鑰匙。
optionExplanations: 正確：表示跪下來找掉落的鑰匙。
錯誤：這句將吃東西和鉛筆亂接在一起，沒有清楚表達片語用途。
錯誤：公車不能跪在人的膝蓋上；可說 The bus was at the station.
錯誤：這裡想說放在膝上應用 on my lap，且 tomorrow 不搭配過去式 put 的語境。

vocabulary.usage: 非常希望對方答應時使用；後面接人和 to + 動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Beg someone to」？
options: I begged to my brother help my dog.
I begged my brother to help me find my dog.
She begged her sandwich to dance.
They begged happy to the football.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：begged + 人 + to help，表示懇求哥哥幫忙。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：詞序錯誤；應說 I begged my brother to help my dog.
正確：begged + 人 + to help，表示懇求哥哥幫忙。
錯誤：通常不會對三明治懇求跳舞；可對人說 She begged her friend to dance.
錯誤：beg 後面需要合理的對象和動作；可說 They begged their dad to play football.

vocabulary.usage: 答應的事沒做好，或沒達到別人的期待時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Let someone down」？
options: Please let my bag down a birthday cake.
I let the rain down in my pencil.
I promised to come, but I forgot. I let my friend down.
My teacher let down the classroom to Tuesday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：沒有履行約定，讓朋友失望。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：let someone down 是讓人失望，不是用來放蛋糕。
錯誤：這裡不能表示雨下來；可以說 It started to rain.
正確：沒有履行約定，讓朋友失望。
錯誤：這個句型不能表示移動教室或改日期。

vocabulary.usage: 開始愛上一個人，也可以用來說非常喜歡某個地方或事物。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Fall in love with」？
options: I fall in love with my homework at seven o’clock as a bus.
She fell in love with him when they met at school.
He fell in love the door with a spoon.
We fell in love to the supermarket yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示兩人在學校認識時，她愛上了他。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：後半句 as a bus 讓意思不合理；可說 I fell in love with this book.
正確：表示兩人在學校認識時，她愛上了他。
錯誤：fall in love 後要接 with，且句意不合理。
錯誤：應用 with 表示愛上；去超市則說 We went to the supermarket.

vocabulary.usage: 可以表示物品倒過來，也可以表示生活出現很大的改變。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Turn upside down」？
options: I turned upside down my breakfast for blue.
My sister turned upside down at five o’clock the song.
We turned the weather upside down in our pockets.
The baby turned the box upside down, and all the toys fell out.

vocabulary.meaning: 在不理想的情況下盡力做好
vocabulary.usage: 事情不如預期時，努力利用現有條件。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Make the best of」？
options: It rained on our trip, but we made the best of the day.
I made the best of my shoes into a banana.
She makes the best of to sleep at nine.
They made the best of loudly in the bus.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：雖然下雨，還是努力讓這天過得開心。
optionExplanations: 正確：雖然下雨，還是努力讓這天過得開心。
錯誤：這個片語不是把東西變成香蕉；可說 I made a banana cake.
錯誤：make the best of 後面應接名詞或情況，不直接接 to sleep。
錯誤：loudly 是副詞，不能作為這個片語的受詞。

vocabulary.usage: 努力過，但沒有達到希望的結果時使用。
options: We looked for the lost cat in vain; we could not find it.
I put the sandwich in vain and ate the table.
She is in vain tall than her brother.
My bike in vain to school every morning.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示找了貓卻沒有找到。
optionExplanations: 正確：表示找了貓卻沒有找到。
錯誤：in vain 不是實際的容器或位置。
錯誤：in vain 不表示身高比較；應說 She is taller than her brother.
錯誤：in vain 不能代替騎車這個動詞；可說 I ride my bike to school.
